source_gate: fresh3 support-audit must exist and equal FRESH3_ATOMGIT_MSR_SOURCE_POOL_10_QUALIFIED with attempted=10, valid=10, ten repositories, no failure layer, no replacement/top-up. Every source trajectory and writer-input trajectory must pass its content-address check. All downstream scientific phase entry points revalidate this gate.

writer.provider_sampling: provider-managed; exactly one valid realized draw per unit/branch; persist and content-address before binder; no semantic reroll

binder.provider_sampling: provider-managed; exactly one valid realized draw per unit/branch/context; persist and content-address before shadow; no semantic reroll
binder.format: nonempty single-line text, at most 60 whitespace-delimited words

shadow.action_signature: exact first fenced bash command; no post-hoc canonicalization

final.provider_sampling: provider-managed; conditional on already content-addressed writer/binder states
final.endpoint: per-unit empirical TV between success-writer and failure-writer first-action distributions
pilot_pass: positive D_select unit count > negative count

estimand: State-conditional mechanism pilot: downstream empirical action distributions are conditional on exactly one realized, content-addressed writer draw per branch and one realized, content-addressed binder draw per branch/context. Writer/binder stochasticity is part of the realized state. This is not a temperature-matched Qwen397 replication and not an average causal effect over writer/binder randomness.

resource_envelope.rationale: The original aggregate 1M output-token cap is not portable because AtomCode counts provider-managed hidden reasoning in completion tokens. The AtomGit lane instead freezes the exact request geometry and the deterministic sum of per-call completion ceilings before downstream scientific execution.

temperature.claim: No temperature equivalence with Qwen397. All AtomGit downstream calls use provider-managed sampling characterized by Q0.6.

forbidden: execute downstream scientific phases unless fresh3 source support is 10/10 valid
replace or top-up a source or pilot unit
reroll provider-valid writer/binder states for semantic preference
change Q0.5/Q0.6 ceilings after downstream outcomes
change shadow blocks/sample counts/gate thresholds after downstream outcomes
run final after mechanism gate failure
switch model to rescue a gate
